label: Water purifier

questions.text: Is your water source a borewell, tanker or municipal supply?
questions.why: Hard or salty water wears the membrane faster.

questions.text: Roughly how much purified water is used each day?
questions.why: Heavy use wears the filters faster.

questions.text: When were the filters or membrane last changed?
questions.why: Old filters stop cleaning the water well.

questions.text: Has the taste or smell of the water changed?
questions.why: A change can mean the filters need attention.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Have you noticed leaks, slow flow or the purifier running non-stop?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the purifier before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the purifier yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Have the filters and membrane changed by the brand's service on schedule.
care_tips.why: Old filters stop cleaning the water properly.

care_tips.text: If your water is hard or from a borewell, ask the brand's service about the right settings and service interval.
care_tips.why: Hard water wears the membrane faster.

care_tips.text: Use a surge protector if the power is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Power swings can damage the pump and UV lamp.

care_tips.text: Ask for the storage tank to be cleaned at service visits.
care_tips.why: A clean tank keeps the water safe.

care_tips.text: If it leaks, the flow slows or it runs non-stop, switch it off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Leaks and non-stop running can damage the pump.

reminders.text: Book a water purifier service and filter check.
reminders.note: Check your manual and warranty card for the recommended filter schedule.
